registration: Commit exact source/request/options/outcomes before comparative execution. Keep every failure and correction. Local registration predates runs; server publication may be later. No external holdout.
population: All 32 PR41 development requests, plus seven goal-change, short-circuit, unused-local and horizon cases. Same retained guarded all-positive/fixed-width signed semantics. PR42 physical phases are a separate profile.
candidate_language: Fixed PR41 native schemas only: source input sign/zero bridges, source-local equality-mask implications, constant least-bit projections, guard-zero, target guard truth and local word/Boolean identities. Concrete questions are generated from the independent consumer, current checked separating model, source formula and word IR dependencies. No fixture names, expected values or supplied observation list enter the planner.
policy: Deterministic consumer-matching bridges, target questions, then sufficient congruence/Boolean pullbacks and local IR dependency expansion. Inspect syntax to propose a question, never execute its native semantic rule while ranking. Stop immediately when checked consumer proof closes; failed questions stay in the ledger and cache. Recheck after each extension of E.
horizons: Activate the query endpoints first; distinguish checked not_visible from not_entailed at the complete finite horizon. Grow the horizon before diagnosing a source-fact gap. A configured horizon ceiling can leave an explicit unresolved obligation; inactive queries carry only syntactic evidence, never a separating model.
models: Every negative ground checkpoint is independently checked against its exact E and horizon. Extending E invalidates all previous lower models for the next decision. Historical models remain evidence only for their own snapshot; no source refutation follows from them.
routes: planner: adaptive native questions plus Paper II query-subterm proofs
ordinary: identical adaptive question policy and ordinary unfiltered congruence closure; bounded-horizon diagnostic uses the common checked Paper II backend when a full ordinary query is disallowed
eager: unchanged PR41 fixed native collection, then the same guarded consumer proof and explicit fallback policy
A1: No source forcing is enabled in the signed profile. PR42's local bridge and lack of utility do not authorize a cross-profile transfer. Candidate selection and early stopping can be useful independently of I. Common-lemmata reuse across independent goals is PR44, not this PR.
failure_layers: Report insufficient horizon, nonconsequence of current E, need for further source facts, exhausted candidate representation, resource budget and concrete source violation separately. Semantic certificates establish ground status or a checked word counterexample. Search-exhaustion diagnosis and runtime trace remain reproducible diagnostics, not proofs of global impossibility.
fallback: Explicit opt-in retained guarded covered-source fallback only after native language exhaustion and bounded witness search. Charge all preceding failed attempts and all fallback work; never import an unguarded target verdict.
measurements: all source parses and guard-domain work
candidate syntax scans, ordering and native attempts including failures/cache hits
every E extension and invalidated model
all intermediate closure searches, models and checks
final native facts, ground terms and portable proof bytes
instrumented time per stage and complete route
comparison: Sequential once per exact case and route, with fresh semantic state and ordinary caches allowed. No best-run selection. Timings are diagnostic, process/module caches persist, no speedup ranking. Separate saved native work from total planner overhead. Any benefit from rule schemas or question policy is not automatically a Paper I/II theorem benefit.
acceptance: Registered mask and arithmetic families close before a full source interface, stop without later native questions, change chosen questions when the consumer changes, reject wrong source conclusions, invalidate old models after E growth and replay all completed consumer proofs without planner/search imports. Preserve budget/unsupported/unresolved/fallback cases in the denominator.
preservation: All accepted PR42 files remain byte-identical except the existing current workflow and additive test registry
